faq_heading: Burnaby Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' October 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Burnaby townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in Burnaby was $839,300 in October 2026 (-4.9% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Burnaby townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

279 townhomes sold in Burnaby with a median price of $900,000 (the middle half sold between $754,000 and $1,075,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $672 per square foot, a median year built of 2001 and a median strata fee of $455 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, October 2026 (released November 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Burnaby East: the townhomes benchmark was $839,300 in October 2026. Over the past year it fell 4.9%; over three months it fell 2.3%; over the last month it fell 2.2%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 6.8%; over 5 years it rose 12.5%; over 10 years it rose 59.4%. Burnaby North: the townhomes benchmark was $873,000 in October 2026. Over the past year it fell 5.3%; over three months it fell 1.5%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.8%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 5.1%; over 5 years it rose 8.7%; over 10 years it rose 58.4%. Burnaby South: the townhomes benchmark was $922,900 in October 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.8%; over three months it was little changed (-0.1%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it fell 2.0%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 9.9%; over 5 years it rose 4.6%; over 10 years it rose 46.8%.
Townhomes against other home types in Burnaby

Burnaby East: the townhomes benchmark of $839,300 sits $842,300 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,681,600 (50% of it) and $140,500 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $698,800 (120% of it). Burnaby North: the townhomes benchmark of $873,000 sits $922,200 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,795,200 (49% of it) and $212,600 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $660,400 (132% of it). Burnaby South: the townhomes benchmark of $922,900 sits $981,500 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,904,400 (48% of it) and $206,400 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $716,500 (129% of it).

blocks.text: Before you buy townhomes in Burnaby
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What did townhomes in Burnaby sell for?
faq.a: 279 townhomes sold in Burnaby between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $900,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Burnaby?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Burnaby sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 279 townhomes that sold in Burnaby went for between $754,000 and $1,075,000, around a median of $900,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Burnaby sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 279 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.3% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Burnaby?
faq.a: Of the 279 sales, 272 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $455.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Burnaby?
faq.a: The median year built was 2001 for the 279 townhomes sold in Burnaby.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Burnaby usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Burnaby had 3 bedrooms, from the 279 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Burnaby communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Edmonds BE (32), Metrotown (31), Highgate (23), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Burnaby buildings sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Simon Fraser Village (11), Greentree Village (6), The Monterey (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Burnaby?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Burnaby (Burnaby East) was $839,300 in October 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Burnaby?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 1.7%. Over three months it was little changed (-0.7%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Burnaby a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Burnaby had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Burnaby?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Burnaby that match what you want.
